meta.name: lsp-setup
meta.description: Configure a Language Server (LSP) for a specific language so editor/agent tooling — diagnostics, go-to-definition, find-references, rename — works. Use when you need to: configure LSP, lsp setup, set up or install a language server, fix 'no LSP server configured' / 'server not installed', choose between servers (basedpyright vs pyright vs ty vs ruff), or wire .codex/lsp-client.json / .opencode/lsp.json. 언어서버 설정. Routes by file extension to references/<language>/README.md for the exact builtin server, per-OS install commands (macOS/Linux/Windows), config snippets for both config files, initialization options, alternatives, and troubleshooting. Ships scripts: detect-lsp.ts (scan a project for languages + each server's install/config status) and verify-lsp.ts (run a real diagnostics roundtrip). Covers typescript, python, go, rust, c/c++, java, kotlin, c#/razor, swift, ruby, php, dart, elixir, zig, lua, bash, yaml, terraform, haskell, julia.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同语言配置 LSP 或修复编辑器诊断功能
copy.tagline_en: Configure language servers for your project to enable code diagnostics and navigation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to set up or fix LSP for different languages in your editor

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为项目配置对应的语言服务(LSP),让改代码时能查错误、跳转定义、查找引用。它会先识别项目语言,再按系统执行安装命令,把配置写进两个配置文件,最后跑一次真实诊断来确认服务器能启动。
howto.when: 当你说要“配置 LSP”、“安装语言服务器”,或想修复“未配置语言服务器/服务器未安装”的报错,或要求在两款服务器之间选型时触发;也会在提到那两个配置文件时进入。

say.text: 帮我看看这个 Python 项目缺哪个语言服务器,并装上。
say.note: 会扫描项目并报告安装状态

say.text: 把 TypeScript 的 LSP 配好,再验证一下。
say.note: 会写入配置并跑一次诊断验证

say.text: 我在用 basedpyright 和 pyright,帮我选一个并解释区别。
say.note: 会对比备选服务器并给出建议

howto.what_en: Claude configures the right Language Server for a project so diagnostics, go-to-definition, find-references, and rename work. It detects languages, installs the server, writes config, and verifies with a real diagnostics roundtrip.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to configure/install a language server, fix 'no LSP server configured'/'server not installed' errors, choose between servers, or wire .codex/lsp-client.json / .opencode/lsp.json.

say_en.text: Scan this Python project, tell me which language server is missing, and install it.
say_en.note: Runs detect-lsp.ts and reports install status.

say_en.text: Set up the TypeScript LSP and verify it with a real check.
Compare basedpyright and pyright for this project and pick one.
say_en.note: Consults the Python reference and gives a recommendation.
